items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: let's say Shaw has got Roscoe Robinson, or Roscoe Gardner, Ray Charles. Let's use him as a picture, you know.

ctx.x: And she was in there. Right. Why'd you get involved in the film?

Well, she came to me and asked me to, she had made a record, and it wasn't so good a good record. And so she came to me and asked me to book it. And so I told her, the only thing you could do was to be, to get a record. So we got a record on her. Which one? Killing her, Imperial Labor. And it really went over for her. So she was on there ever since. Now I had, after, after Ehrman, I had another artist, Chris Kenner. I recorded him. He had several good numbers. Chris, Chris died back in L.A. So I guess you'd call…
